description: The wrapper/skill spawn gate is double-evaluated with contradictory parameters. spawnEligible (REQ-S1 cond 3) calls decideSpawn with maxChildren=config.spawn_hard_cap (REQ-S7 default 5) and minBalanceUsdc=config.spawn_threshold_usdc. But the REAL run.sh re-runs the gate itself (run.sh:61-66) with ONLY {balanceUsdc, children}, falling back to decideSpawn's hardcoded defaults minBalanceUsdc=20, rateLimitDays=14, maxChildren=1 (spawn-decision.js:11-13). Consequences: (a) REQ-S7 'Hard cap: at most spawn_hard_cap (default 5) total registered children' is contradicted — run.sh returns reason:'max_children' and exits 0 (dormant) as soon as children.length>=1, so the wrapper can pass while run.sh refuses the 2nd..5th child; (b) run.sh reads parent balance from $STATE_DIR/wallet.json '.balance_usdc' (run.sh:48-51), a different file and schema than the secp256k1 key file ~/.automaton/wallet.json the spec's wallet model (REQ-R1/R2/S2c) uses — on the real automaton runtime that field is absent, so BAL=0 -> decideSpawn low_balance -> spawn never fires. The spec never reconciles run.sh's internal gate, balance source, or the maxChildren default with its own config-driven REQ-S1/S7 values.

evidence.snippet: BAL="$("$JQ" -r '.balance_usdc // 0' "$WALLET_JSON" ...)"  ...  decideSpawn({ balanceUsdc: balance, children })  # defaults maxChildren=1, minBalanceUsdc=20
